notes: Timeline = gapless mp3 decode (ffmpeg/libsndfile/browsers); Demucs stems shifted to match. Tempo is constant: 132.221 BPM (period 0.45378 s), fitted over the whole song on drum+mix onset envelopes (search range 130.6-141.4 BPM), phase refined on kick attack times (residual sd 23.7 ms); first beat 0.243 s. The grid is extrapolated through drum-less passages. Bar phase: 4 beats per bar, first downbeat = beat 1 (0.697 s), chosen by chord changes, bass-note onsets and kick-vs-snare on the beat (or song.json downbeat_phase); bar k starts at first_downbeat + k*4*period. Sections start on downbeats and follow the lyric sections of lyrics.txt (a pickup in the second half of a bar stays in the previous section; instrumentals of 2+ bars, intro and outro get their own sections), unless song.json section_bars overrides them. Envelopes: 100 fps, frame i centred at i/100 s, 46 ms RMS window, one-pole smoothing (10 ms attack / 90 ms release), each divided by its own 99th percentile and clipped to 0..1 (linear amplitude). low <150 Hz, mid 150-2000 Hz, high >4 kHz of the full mix; vocal/drums/bass/other = stem RMS. Onsets [time, strength 0-1] from the drums stem: kick = attack (steepest rise) of the <120 Hz band (305); snare = 1.5-5 kHz attacks whose 0.5-5 kHz noise tail 40-120 ms later is in the loudest local class (199); hat = >7 kHz attacks not within 40 ms of a snare or 30 ms of a kick (305). vocal = note onsets from the vocal stem (log-mel flux peaks + legato pitch jumps > 0.8 semitone), including backing vocals / ad-libs.
